positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Co-Founder of FTR Tech - A Sports Management CRM seeking to automate and connect the personal training world.
• Devise strategic direction for the company, leading a team of 4 engineers to efficiently execute project tasks and achieve key objectives.
• Engineered a robust and scalable system architecture, leveraging API Gateway, Cloud Functions, Firebase, Node.js, and Pub‑Sub for backend
operations, complemented by a React Native‑powered frontend.
• Utilize Google Cloud Pub/Sub, Google Cloud Functions, Node.js, and GitLab webhooks to send notifications in case of service runtime anomalies
or surpassing our designated Google Cloud spending limit.
• Establish CI/CD, enabling automation of cloud function infrastructure in GCP, customizing build pipelines for each of the 8 microservices, code
linting and providing real‑time notifications for build statuses.
positions.insights: System Design, Start-up Leadership and +3 skills

positions.title: Cyber Security Engineer
positions.description:
• Use AWS Lambda, Python (Boto3), and Terraform to write and create resources for cloud auto-remediation scripts within Travelers' Enterprise AWS environment
• Review and assess new cloud services (GCP and AWS) and the extent of their security configurations

positions.title: Software Engineer (EBIA AI Team)
positions.description:
• Used AWS (Lambda, SQS) and Alexa Developer Console to extend the functionality of Travelers’ authenticated skill
• Used Nuxt JS and Python created an internal intelligent search, that uses NLP to return associated documents
• Created a CI/CD pipeline using CloudBees Jenkins, UCD, and Github Webhooks with Slack integration for build status updates

positions.title: Software Engineer (PI Innovation)
positions.description:
•	Utilizing agile strategies, aided in the development of Traverse, a new insurance product targeting millennials, developed in 8 months.
•	Using Nightwatch JS was able to build end to end tests for the application.
•	Utilized AWS, Maria DB, Vue JS, Express JS, and Node JS.

projects.title: FTR Tech
projects.description: FTR (pronounced Fit‐er) is a mobile application allowing for individuals to request a trainer in a variety of activities instantaneously. The applications (Coach Application and Trainee Application) are built on GCP utilizing Cloud Functions and Firebase.

projects.title: SnapCat
projects.description: Created a proof of concept using artificial intelligence to find latent variables in Travelers’ insured properties, assessing fire risk in metro areas.

patents.title: Systems and methods for artificial intelligence (AI) driving analysis and incentives
patents.description: Created a proof of concept to address poor teen driving habits with 5 other developers. Driving habits were rated using a Raspberry Pi, running AI that was trained to detect ”good” and ”bad” driving behaviors. Using gamification, we reinforced the good habits using our iPhone app.

organizations.name: dev/color A*
organizations.description: /dev/color is the premier global career accelerator for Black software engineers, technologists, and executives. It serves as the trusted accountability partner for companies that invest in, employ, and are led by these professionals.

organizations.name: National Society of Black Engineers
organizations.position: Vice President, Secretary, Telecommunications Chairperson · Aug 2011 - May 2016
organizations.description:
Chapter Vice President
•	Corresponded with other chapters and NSBE regional and National Chairs to ensure the chapter is in good standing
•	Organized and coordinated several general body E-Board meetings

Chapter Secretary
•	Communicated to all members regarding important information regarding NSBE, and both professional and academic opportunities

Telecommunications Chairperson
•	Created and maintained the official NSBE Website for the University of Connecticut
•	Graphic designer for all posters, flyers, and email templates for the chapter
